title: Hold a licence to sell native animals
what: Sell an animal that is not an exempt animal only as one of the Act's exceptions allows (such as under a licence; the exceptions are in s 153).

sources.title: Nature Conservation Act 2014 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 134(1) (current republication (R35, from 26 December 2025; Nature Conservation Act 2014 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person sells an animal; and (b) the animal is not an exempt animal

sources.title: Nature Conservation Act 2014 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 273(2), words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current republication (R35, from 26 December 2025; Nature Conservation Act 2014 | Acts)
sources.quote: The conservator may issue the licence to the applicant only if reasonably satisfied that— (a) the applicant is a suitable person to hold the licence;
